Network.Technology: 3.9G: FDD-LTE (au VoLTE) (700 MHz/N800 MHz/2 GHz), 3G: W-CDMA (850 MHz/2 GHz), 2G: GSM (1.9 GHz/1.8 GHz/900 MHz)

Body.Dimensions: 149 mm H , 72 mm W , 8.0 mm D

Memory.Card slot: microSDHC (up to 32 GB), microSDXC (up to 256 GB) (officially supported by KDDI)

Display.Display: Main: 5.2-inch IPS display, WQHD (2560 × 1440 pixels), approx. 16.77 million colors, Secondary: IPS display, 160 × 1040 pixels, approx. 16.77 million colors

Cameras.Rear camera: Approx. 16.0 megapixels + approx. 8.0 megapixels (dual camera), backside-illuminated CMOS image sensor, image stabilization (video recording supported), face recognition, laser autofocus, dual flash

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3.9/4G: FDD-LTE / LTE-Advanced (au 4G LTE / au 4G LTE CA) (700 MHz/N800 MHz/2 GHz), WiMAX 2.1 (WiMAX 2+), 3.5G: UMTS (W-CDMA), Other: Wireless LAN (IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac 5 GHz/2.4 GHz)
